name: Afonso de Albuquerque
bio: Albuquerque presses for the captives’ release. A merchant negotiating for the safety of a household may find a safeguard does not answer every later demand.
notes: fact: Albuquerque led the 1511 expedition and negotiated over the captives before the assaults on Melaka (1511-events.md §1)
gameplay: Specific safeguards for the roster and their consequences are authored scenarios unless attributed to a source (people-factions.md §§1, 3)
